metadata_scope: Only CUDA activity records and their referenced names. Process environment and unrelated string-table entries omitted.
kernel_grouping: Name, graph node ID when present, launch dimensions and resource use. Equal names alone do not identify the same kernel.
duration_scope: Sum of captured kernel durations / 10 invocations; overlapping kernels double-count work. This is not critical-path or wall-clock time.
interpretation: Captured profiler range only. Activity counts are not semantic operation counts; resolve library/internal graph kernels from correlation IDs.
